results.name: object_change_color_evaluate
results.evidence: Iterates an object's region change-color records, evaluates the function chain via FUN_00453180 and matrix4x3_transform_point, and defaults to the colors in PTR_DAT_0069672c/00696718 while switching on the record's type field (0-3).
results.summary: Evaluates the change-color function chain for each region of an object and writes the resulting primary/secondary colors back into the object's render state.

results.name: effect_event_apply
results.evidence: Dispatches on the effect part's tag-group hash ('obje','deca','jpt!','ligh','pctl','snd!'), calling object creation, decal spawn, damage_apply_area_effect, light spawn, particle_system_new, and sound playback respectively.
results.summary: Applies a single effect event/part by tag group, spawning the corresponding object, decal, damage, light, particle system, or sound.

results.name: object_function_chain_resolve
results.evidence: Recursively walks a function-input linked list (DAT_0087abe0 table, 0x3c stride), selecting the next link based on param_3 and bit 0x8000 of the entry's flags.
results.summary: Walks a chained object-function-input list to resolve the active link for the given evaluation mode.

results.name: object_get_node_matrix_pointer
results.evidence: When the node's high bit is set, resolves a first-person-weapon node matrix at DAT_006b2d98 (matching FUN_00453b10's fp-weapon node usage); otherwise resolves the regular model's node array via the object's tag definition.
results.summary: Returns a pointer to a skeletal node's transform, special-casing first-person weapon nodes.

results.name: transition_function_evaluate
results.evidence: Switches over a curve-type parameter implementing step, squared (early), (2-x)x (late), and (3-2x)x^2 (smooth) easing curves, matching Blam's standard transition shapes.
results.summary: Evaluates a standard easing/transition curve (linear, early, late, smooth, or step) for a 0..1 input.

results.name: local_player_near_point
results.evidence: Loops over up to 2 local players (DAT_0087a478 table) testing squared distance to *in_EDX against 100.0 (10 units), or short-circuits true when a difficulty/player-count field exceeds 2.
results.summary: Returns whether any local player is within 10 world units of a given point.

results.name: object_marker_environment_probe
results.evidence: Offsets a marker position by a fixed vector and 0.15 on Z, calls FUN_00505880 (line/collision test), and on a hit calls FUN_0053ed60 and FUN_00453490 to spawn a marker effect.
results.summary: Probes the environment near an object marker and, on a hit, triggers a marker-attached effect.

results.name: object_marker_spawn_effect_and_sound
results.evidence: Resolves an object marker's world position, calls FUN_00450980 to place something there when one tag field is valid, and FUN_00543d80 (color+id args) for a second tag field.
results.summary: Spawns an effect and/or sound at a specific marker on a specific object.

results.name: particle_system_delete_all
results.evidence: Guarded by a 'dirty' flag on the particle-system table header, iterates every entry via FUN_004d0630 calling FUN_00453f60 (particle-system delete) until exhausted, then clears the flag.
results.summary: Deletes every active particle system, used to fully reset the particle system pool.

results.name: particle_system_new
results.evidence: Allocates a 0x158-byte datum in the particle-system table (DAT_0087abd4), stores the pctl tag id (param_1) and position/forward/velocity vectors from EAX/ECX/EDX, then initializes it via FUN_004538b0, deleting on failure.
results.summary: Creates a new particle system instance at a given position/orientation from a pctl tag.

results.name: particle_system_new_on_object_marker
results.evidence: Same allocation pattern as FUN_00453600 but derives placement from param_2 (object index) and in_AX (marker index) via the object's node array at tag offset 0x144.
results.summary: Creates a new particle system instance attached to a marker on an object.

results.name: particle_system_initialize_particle_types
results.evidence: Iterates the pctl tag's particle-type block (offset 0x5c), initializing each per-instance sub-record and rolling a random initial age from the type's min/max age fields.
results.summary: Initializes per-particle-type runtime state for a newly created particle system.

results.name: particle_system_find_matching_object
results.evidence: Walks the global particle-system iteration table via data_iterator_next comparing each entry's associated object id against param_1, returning a tri-state result.
results.summary: Searches active particle systems for one associated with a given object and reports a match state.

results.name: particle_system_type_spawn_particles
results.evidence: Computes a target particle count for one particle-type slot from object/marker rate data (first_person_weapon_get_marker_data, FUN_0050fcd0), then datum_new's entries in a 0x80-stride table and invokes a per-shape constructor via the &DAT_00657444 function-pointer table.
results.summary: Spawns new child particle records for one particle-type of a particle system, up to its target emission count.

results.name: particle_system_delete
results.evidence: For each particle-type slot walks and datum_delete's every linked particle record, then datum_delete's the particle-system entry itself.
results.summary: Deletes a particle system and all of its spawned particle records.

results.name: particle_system_update_all
results.evidence: Iterates every particle-system datum via FUN_004d0630 calling FUN_004544f0(param_1, index) for each, matching the per-tick update pattern.
results.summary: Updates every active particle system for one simulation tick.

results.name: particle_system_refresh_local_player_bindings
results.evidence: Callers=0 (dead code); iterates all particle systems, resolving/clearing a local-player index (FUN_005013a0, DAT_00746f9c+0xe4) per system and per particle-type slot.
results.summary: Unused routine that would re-resolve local-player associations for every particle system and its particle-type slots.

results.name: object_marker_random_point_in_bounds
results.evidence: Reads an object-definition marker/region record (stride 0x178) and writes randomly interpolated values between its min/max fields into the output vector.
results.summary: Generates a random point/normal pair interpolated within a marker region's stored bounds.

results.name: sequence_index_advance
results.evidence: Steps a ping-pong index (in_EAX[0]/[1]) by +-1, and on hitting the bound either clamps, wraps, or reflects direction based on flag bits 0/1 of in_ECX+0x20.
results.summary: Advances a bounded, optionally looping/ping-ponging index by one step.

results.name: sequence_index_advance_secondary
results.evidence: Same ping-pong stepping logic as FUN_004543b0 but against a different bound (in_ECX+0x74) and flag bits 2/3.
results.summary: Advances a second bounded, optionally looping index by one step, mirroring FUN_004543b0 for a different field.

results.name: particle_system_update
results.evidence: Recomputes object position/velocity scaling for the system, invokes a per-system-type update via the &DAT_0065743c function-pointer table, then iterates and updates each particle-type slot's interpolated position/orientation and colors; deletes the system via FUN_00453f60 when finished.
results.summary: Per-tick update for a single particle system: advances physics, evaluates its behavior callback, and updates each particle-type's render state.

results.name: particle_system_refresh_cluster_bit
results.evidence: Iterates particle systems via FUN_004d0630, testing each system's stored cluster/region index against a changed-bit array (DAT_0087a478+0x58) and calling FUN_00454bf0 when set.
results.summary: Re-evaluates particle systems whose BSP cluster/region was marked as changed.

results.name: particle_system_update_lighting
results.evidence: For each active particle-type slot walks a light list (DAT_007c3350 bit array, DAT_007c3178.. light position/color globals), computes matrix4x3_transform_point and blends between two lights based on a falloff ratio.
results.summary: Recomputes local lighting contribution for each active particle-type slot of a particle system from nearby scene lights.

results.name: particle_new
results.evidence: Allocates a 0x70-byte datum in the particle table (DAT_0087abd0, referenced by later functions), copying shader/random range fields from the particle-type block and computing lifetime/fade via random_range_real.
results.summary: Creates a new individual particle from a particle-type definition.

results.name: particle_update_all
results.evidence: Iterates the particle table (DAT_0087abd0, 0x70 stride) via FUN_004d0630, advancing age by param_1 and either deleting expired particles or dispatching to FUN_004560c0/FUN_004561a0/FUN_00456550.
results.summary: Per-tick update for every active particle: ages, animates, or deletes each one.

results.name: particle_delete_by_type
results.evidence: Iterates the particle table deleting entries whose stored particle-type index matches unaff_BX and whose flag bit 0x40 is set.
results.summary: Deletes all live particles belonging to a specific particle type.

results.name: particle_advance_sequence_state
results.evidence: Drives a 4-state machine (field +0xe) selecting a random sprite-sheet frame index from ranges (+0x98/0x9a/0x9c/0x9e) on the particle-type tag, matching a sprite animation start/loop/end sequence.
results.summary: Advances a particle's sprite sequence state machine and picks the next random frame index.

results.name: particle_advance_frame_hold
results.evidence: Manages a frame-hold counter, refreshing it from a per-frame duration table (iVar1+0x58) via FUN_00455e60 when exhausted.
results.summary: Decrements/refreshes a particle's current-frame hold counter, advancing the sequence when it expires.

results.name: particle_animation_advance
results.evidence: Loops calling FUN_00456000 to consume elapsed time (param_1) across per-frame durations, matching a fixed-timestep animation advance.
results.summary: Advances a particle's frame animation across a given elapsed time by repeatedly consuming per-frame durations.

results.name: particle_physics_update
results.evidence: When unattached performs a collision test via FUN_0050b530 and on impact spawns marker effects/sounds (FUN_00453330/FUN_00453490) or deletes the particle; when attached to an object blends velocity toward the object via object_try_and_get and damping curves.
results.summary: Updates a particle's motion, handling collision response and object-attached particle damping.

results.name: particle_apply_impact_or_delete
results.evidence: Checks the particle-type's impact-effect tag field (+0x100 on its definition) and either calls FUN_004565a0(0) to trigger it or datum_delete's the particle.
results.summary: Triggers a particle's impact effect if one is defined, otherwise deletes the particle.

results.name: particle_impact_response_dispatch
results.evidence: Dispatches on a tag-group magic: 'effe' calls vector3d_normalize_with_length + FUN_00450980 (effect spawn); 'snd!' calls FUN_00543d80 (sound play).
results.summary: Dispatches a particle's impact response, spawning an effect or playing a sound depending on the referenced tag's group.

results.name: particle_compute_current_scale
results.evidence: Linearly interpolates between an object type's min/max radius (offsets 0x74/0x78) using the particle's lifetime fraction (+0x14/+0x18), then multiplies by the particle's base scale (+0x5c).
results.summary: Computes a particle's current render scale from its lifetime fraction and the owning object type's radius range.

results.name: contrail_clear_invalid
results.evidence: Iterates the fixed contrail array (DAT_006f1884, 0xec stride) via an index walk over DAT_0087a478, zeroing an entry's fields whenever its associated object slot is missing or invalid.
results.summary: Clears out contrail instances whose owning object no longer exists.

results.name: contrail_emit_point_by_distance
results.evidence: When the accumulated distance (param_1) exceeds a stored threshold, evaluates periodic_function_evaluate and blends new point-density/emission values into the contrail record at DAT_006f1884[in_DX].
results.summary: Emits/updates a contrail segment once the object has traveled far enough since the last point.

results.name: contrail_update_from_position
results.evidence: Computes an object's traveled distance via object_get_position against a cached point, then forwards it to FUN_004567c0.
results.summary: Computes distance traveled since the last update and forwards it to the contrail point-emission routine.

results.name: contrail_add_point
results.evidence: Resolves a contrail slot index from the object table (DAT_0087a480) and forwards to FUN_004578a0 with a fixed scale of 1.0.
results.summary: Adds a new point to an object's contrail if one is currently attached.

results.name: contrail_reset_and_add_point
results.evidence: Zero-initializes a large local contrail-point scratch buffer, fills default color from PTR_DAT_006851fc, then calls FUN_004578a0 and FUN_00457d50 to (re)seed the contrail.
results.summary: Resets a contrail's point buffer to defaults and adds an initial point.

results.name: contrail_create_for_object
results.evidence: Checks a validity flag on *in_EAX, otherwise walks data_iterator_next to find a slot via FUN_004ec590/FUN_004ec670, and forwards packed state to FUN_00456cf0.
results.summary: Allocates or looks up a contrail slot for an object and hands off to the contrail creation routine.

results.name: contrail_send_network_update
results.evidence: Validates a contrail slot index, builds a message payload from object/point data, calls message_delta_encode_message and network_session_send_to_machine to replicate the contrail point to clients.
results.summary: Encodes and sends a network update for a newly added contrail point.

results.name: contrail_create
results.evidence: Resolves a contrail slot from the object table, adds a point (FUN_004578a0/FUN_004579b0/FUN_00457d50), then for local players tests facing/visibility via local_player_to_player_index, object_try_and_get and vector3d_cross_product/fpatan before flagging the contrail's visibility bytes.
results.summary: Creates or extends a contrail on an object and evaluates local-player visibility/facing to set its render flags.

results.name: contrail_compute_segment_color
results.evidence: When not disabled, blends stored min/max color fields via FUN_004ccac0 based on elapsed lifetime, or seeds a fresh segment from the DAT_00687218 color table.
results.summary: Computes the interpolated color/alpha for a contrail segment based on its age.

results.name: contrail_fade_alpha_up
results.evidence: Increments 4 consecutive alpha-like bytes at contrail record offset 0xe4 by a per-tick amount, clamped at 0xff.
results.summary: Fades a contrail's stored alpha bytes upward over time, clamped to 255.

results.name: contrail_random_point_offset
results.evidence: Uses matrix4x3_from_axis_angle with a random rotation seed and a node array at DAT_006b7af4 to produce a jittered offset vector for a contrail point.
results.summary: Computes a randomly-rotated positional jitter offset for a contrail point.

results.name: contrail_get_point_transform
results.evidence: Builds an output transform matrix for a contrail point either from a cached blend (DAT_006f1884 fields 0x118/0x11c/0x120) or freshly via matrix4x3_from_euler_angles/matrix4x3_from_axis_angle/vector3d_cross_product depending on the contrail's fade state.
results.summary: Computes the transform matrix used to render one contrail point, blending between fade-in states.

results.name: contrail_add_point_if_needed
results.evidence: Checks an angle/distance threshold against the last recorded point before copying 14 dwords of new point state into the contrail record and recomputing its next threshold via FUN_006391b4.
results.summary: Adds a new contrail point only if enough angular or distance change has accumulated since the previous point.

results.name: contrail_compute_point_geometry
results.evidence: Computes basis vectors via fcos/fsin of stored yaw/pitch fields, validates them with vector3d_normalize_with_length, then uses vector2d_angle_between and vector3d_rotate_about_axis to orient a new contrail point.
results.summary: Computes the orientation and basis vectors for a new contrail point from the object's stored yaw/pitch.

results.name: contrail_add_scaled_point
results.evidence: Same threshold/copy pattern as FUN_004578a0 but scales width/rate fields by param_2 before copying and re-timestamping.
results.summary: Adds a new contrail point with a caller-supplied scale factor applied to its width/rate.

results.name: weather_instance_activate
results.evidence: Initializes a weather-instance slot (DAT_006b0ae4, 0x9c stride) with a tag id and duration, then rolls random initial ages for every weather particle-type block (0x25c stride) from its age range fields.
results.summary: Activates a weather effect instance for a region and seeds each weather-particle-type's initial random age.

results.name: weather_instance_type_clear
results.evidence: For each weather particle-type of the instance, walks and datum_delete's its linked weather-particle chain, then decrements the active weather instance count.
results.summary: Deletes all weather particles for a weather instance's particle types and deactivates the slot.

results.name: weather_particle_type_update_count
results.evidence: Computes a target count via FUN_006391b4, then repeatedly calls FUN_00458070 to create or datum_delete's entries in the weather-particle-type's linked list until the live count matches.
results.summary: Grows or shrinks the number of live weather particles for one weather-particle-type toward a target count.

results.name: weather_particle_new
results.evidence: Allocates a 0x54-byte datum (DAT_0087abcc table) for a weather instance/type slot, randomizing its start position, velocity and lifetime fields from the weather-particle-type's stored min/max ranges.
results.summary: Creates a new individual weather particle (raindrop/snowflake) with randomized position, velocity and lifetime.

results.name: weather_instance_update
results.evidence: Advances the instance's elapsed time, computes near/far fade ratios per weather-particle-type, calls FUN_00457fc0 to keep particle counts up to target, then updates each live particle's velocity/turbulence via FUN_00628cca and FUN_00458630.
results.summary: Per-tick update for one weather effect instance: fades, replenishes, and advances all of its particles.

results.name: weather_particle_update_physics
results.evidence: Blends velocity toward a randomly-sampled wind direction (DAT_006b7af4 table), performs a collision test via FUN_0050b530 for splash/impact, then integrates position via FUN_004588e0.
results.summary: Updates one weather particle's velocity, collision response and position for a tick.

results.name: vector3d_add_directional_noise
results.evidence: Adds param_1-or-0 noise (via FUN_00628cca) to each axis of *unaff_EDI depending on the sign of the corresponding axis in *unaff_ESI.
results.summary: Adds noise to a vector's components, biased by the sign of a reference direction vector.

results.name: weather_compute_billboard_matrix
results.evidence: Builds a rotation/translation matrix in the caller's struct from fixed camera-basis globals (DAT_007c3120.. / DAT_007c31e0..), used to orient weather quads toward the camera.
results.summary: Builds a camera-facing transform matrix for weather rendering geometry.

results.name: weather_update_for_local_player
results.evidence: Gated on DAT_00687350 and a valid local weather tag index (DAT_007c3108); activates/deactivates a weather instance via FUN_00457e20/FUN_00457f00 when the tag changes, evaluates FUN_0053ed60 for its function value, and drives geometry rebuild via FUN_00458bf0.
results.summary: Manages the local player's active weather instance and rebuilds its render geometry each tick.

results.name: weather_find_nearby_regions
results.evidence: Scans up to 8 region records within a param_1 radius of the weather center, matching squared distance against each region's stored radius, returning the matched indices/count.
results.summary: Finds up to 8 nearby regions within a given radius of the weather effect's center.

results.name: weather_build_render_geometry
results.evidence: Consumes the outputs of FUN_00458420/FUN_00458990/FUN_00458b50 and fills very large local float/short arrays, matching a procedural mesh/quad-strip generator for weather rendering.
results.summary: Builds the procedural render geometry (vertex grid) for a weather effect instance.

results.name: weather_update
results.evidence: The hint name 'chimera__weather_update' is confirmed by the code: iterates weather-particle-type blocks in the weather tag (DAT_00746f9c+0x1b4/0x1b8), random-walks direction components each clamped, and computes a per-type wind direction unit vector via fpatan/fcos/fsin.
results.summary: Per-tick update of the global weather system's wind direction random walk for each active weather-particle-type.
